title: UK media fails to disclose defence sector links in nearly 60% of cases
summary: A study by Action on Armed Violence (AOAV) reveals that UK media outlets fail to disclose defense sector connections of quoted experts in nearly 60% of cases, raising concerns about transparency, journalistic integrity, and potential conflicts of interest in defense reporting.
problem_solved: Highlights the lack of transparency in UK media when reporting on defense and military matters with experts who have industry ties
why_valuable: This investigation exposes a systemic transparency gap that undermines public trust in media coverage of defense and security policy, potentially influencing public opinion on matters of war and peace
